simple.prompt: By next November, I ___ at this firm for exactly ten years.
simple.explanation: Future Perfect Continuous (will have been + V-ing) mengukur durasi suatu aktivitas hingga titik tertentu di masa depan.
hints: Menghitung durasi hingga waktu masa depan (by next November).
Formula: will have been + V-ing.

simple.prompt: This time tomorrow, we ___ over the Atlantic on our flight to London.
simple.explanation: Future Continuous (will be + V-ing) menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu spesifik di masa depan.
hints: Aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu di masa depan.
Gunakan 'will be flying'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Perfect dengan 'by 5 p.m.'.
simple.targetSentence: She will have completed the report by 5 p.m.
simple.explanation: Subject + will have completed (selesai) + the report + by 5 p.m.
hints: Aksi selesai sebelum waktu tertentu.
Gunakan 'will have completed the report by 5 p.m.'.

simple.prompt: By the end of this semester, students ___ thirty academic essays.
simple.explanation: Untuk jumlah pencapaian/output terselesaikan di masa depan (thirty essays), gunakan Future Perfect Simple ('will have submitted').
hints: Menyatakan jumlah hasil yang sudah rampung.
Gunakan Future Perfect Simple.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Continuous untuk agenda rutin.
simple.targetSentence: I will be attending the regional conference next Friday.
simple.explanation: I will be attending + the regional conference + next Friday.
hints: Agenda kegiatan masa depan.
Gunakan 'I will be attending the regional conference next Friday'.

simple.prompt: Don't phone at 8 p.m. because we ___ dinner with our clients.
simple.explanation: Aksi yang diprediksi sedang berlangsung saat itu ('will be having dinner').
hints: Sedang berlangsung di masa depan saat dihubungi.
Gunakan 'will be having'.

simple.targetSentence: In June they will have been married for twenty years.
simple.explanation: In June (time marker) + they will have been married / living for twenty years.
hints: Mulai dengan 'In June'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'they will have been married for twenty years'.

simple.prompt: By five o'clock tomorrow, all engineers will have ___ the safety simulation.
simple.explanation: Future Perfect Simple berpola 'will have + V3' menyatakan aksi yang sudah selesai sebelum titik waktu masa depan ('By five o'clock tomorrow').
hints: Ada penanda batas waktu depan 'By five o'clock tomorrow'.
Future Perfect Simple membutuhkan V3 ('completed').

simple.prompt: By next June, our family ___ in Surabaya for ten years.
simple.explanation: Future Perfect Continuous ('will have been + V-ing') menyorot durasi berkelanjutan yang dihitung sampai satu titik di masa depan ('By next June ... for ten years').
hints: Ada batas depan 'By next June' DAN durasi 'for ten years'.
Rumus lengkapnya: 'will have been + V-ing'.

simple.prompt: Will the printing shop ___ printed the brochures before Tuesday noon?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan Future Perfect Simple berpola 'Will + Subject + have + V3?'; selalu pakai 'have' (jangan 'has').
hints: Setelah 'Will + subjek', auxiliary sempurna tetap 'have'.
Pilih 'have'.

simple.prompt: By midnight, the automated script ___ have backed up all user accounts.
simple.explanation: Menyatakan target penyelesaian di masa depan sebelum batas waktu ('By midnight') memakai 'will have + V3'.
hints: Penanda 'By midnight' mengarah ke Future Perfect.
Isi dengan modal 'will'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog rencana proyek mengenai target penyelesaian.
dialogue: Client
Can we review the edited video on Thursday afternoon?
Producer
Yes — our editors ___ exported the final cut by Thursday morning.
simple.explanation: 'By Thursday morning' + V3 'exported' memerlukan Future Perfect Simple ('will have exported').
hints: Perhatikan V3 'exported' dan batas waktu 'by Thursday morning'.
Pasangkan 'will have'.

simple.prompt: Don't visit at eight tonight; we won't have ___ unpacking the lab crates yet.
simple.explanation: Future Perfect negatif ('won't have + V3') menyatakan pekerjaan belum selesai pada jam tertentu nanti malam.
hints: Setelah 'won't have', gunakan V3 'finished'.
Pola negatif Future Perfect: 'won't have + V3'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk auxiliary setelah 'will' dalam kalimat durasi masa depan berikut.
simple.draft: By December, Nina will has been mentoring junior analysts for three full years.
options: By December, Nina will have been mentoring junior analysts for three full years.
By December, Nina will had been mentoring junior analysts for three full years.
By December, Nina will have being mentoring junior analysts for three full years.
simple.explanation: Meskipun subjeknya tunggal ('Nina'), setelah modal 'will' TIDAK PERNAH boleh memakai 'has'; selalu gunakan bentuk dasar 'have' ('will have been mentoring').
hints: Modal 'will' selalu diikuti bentuk dasar 'have', bukan 'has'.
Ubah 'will has' menjadi 'will have'.

simple.prompt: At ten tonight, our colleagues in London ___ boarding their overnight flight.
simple.explanation: Aksi yang SEDANG berlangsung tepat pada titik waktu masa depan tertentu ('At ten tonight') memakai Future Continuous ('will be + V-ing'), bukan Future Perfect.
hints: Kalimat ini menyebut 'At ten tonight' (sedang berlangsung), bukan 'By ten' (sudah selesai).
Aksi sedang berjalan di masa depan memakai 'will be + V-ing'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Perfect Simple dengan penanda waktu 'by Friday'.
simple.targetSentence: The committee will have reviewed every scholarship application by Friday.
simple.explanation: Subjek + will have + V3 ('reviewed') + objek + 'by Friday'.
hints: Awali dengan 'The committee will have reviewed'.
Akhiri dengan 'by Friday'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Perfect Continuous untuk merayakan masa kerja.
simple.targetSentence: Next month, my father will have been teaching economics for thirty years.
simple.explanation: Penanda titik depan + subjek + will have been + V-ing + durasi 'for thirty years'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Next month, my father will have been'.
Pasangkan 'teaching economics for thirty years'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih tenses yang sopan untuk menanyakan agenda orang lain tanpa memaksa.
dialogue: Assistant
Excuse me, Dr. Miller, ___ the laser printer this afternoon?
Dr. Miller
No, go right ahead and print your batch.
intermediate.explanation: Future Continuous ('will you be using...?') digunakan sebagai bentuk bertanya yang sangat sopan (polite inquiry) mengenai rencana seseorang tanpa terkesan menuntut.
hints: Pertanyaan sopan mengenai agenda yang sudah terjadwal.
Gunakan Future Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Stative verb with future milestone: 'By next year, he ___ this vintage automobile for three decades.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Own' adalah kata kerja stative, sehingga tidak boleh menggunakan bentuk continuous. Wajib Future Perfect Simple: 'will have owned'.
hints: 'Own' adalah stative verb.
Gunakan Future Perfect Simple.

intermediate.prompt: Time clauses with Present Simple: 'By the time you ___, we will have prepared the conference room.'
intermediate.explanation: Dalam klausa waktu (time clause) seperti 'by the time / when / as soon as', gunakan Present Simple ('arrive'), bukan future form.
hints: Klausa waktu 'by the time' menggunakan Present Simple.
Gunakan 'arrive'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Perfect dengan klausa waktu.
intermediate.targetSentence: We will have left before you reach the station.
intermediate.explanation: We will have left (Future Perfect) + before you reach the station (Present Simple).
hints: Klausa utama: 'We will have left'.
Klausa waktu: 'before you reach the station'.

intermediate.prompt: Milestone duration: 'By midnight, the marathon runner ___ for twelve consecutive hours.'
intermediate.explanation: Menekankan durasi aktivitas fisik yang berkelanjutan hingga batas waktu tengah malam ('will have been running').
hints: Durasi terus menerus hingga batas waktu.
Gunakan Future Perfect Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Susun pertanyaan Future Continuous yang sopan.
intermediate.targetSentence: Will you be driving to the office tomorrow morning?
intermediate.explanation: Will you be driving + to the office + tomorrow morning?
hints: Pertanyaan sopan: 'Will you be driving'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'to the office tomorrow morning?'.

dialogue: Controller
Will the satellite reach orbit by dawn?
Scientist
Yes, it ___ in orbit for an hour before the solar panels deploy.
intermediate.explanation: Menjelaskan perjalanan duratif sebelum aksi panel surya terbuka ('will have been traveling').
hints: Durasi perjalanan di masa depan.
Gunakan Future Perfect Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Contrast carefully: 'By 2030, engineers ___ four solar islands' (completed count) vs 'By 2030, they ___ solar islands across the archipelago for over a decade' (ongoing duration).
options: will have built / will have been building
will have been building / will have built
intermediate.explanation: Hasil terhitung selesai ('four solar islands') memakai Future Perfect Simple ('will have built'); fokus durasi proses berkelanjutan ('for over a decade') memakai Future Perfect Continuous ('will have been building').
hints: Angka hasil tuntas memakai Future Perfect Simple.
Durasi kerja berkelanjutan memakai Future Perfect Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: How many quarterly reports ___ our compliance unit ___ by the end of December?
intermediate.explanation: Menanyakan total kuantitas yang sudah selesai sebelum tenggat ('How many... by the end of December') memakai Future Perfect Simple ('will ... have filed').
hints: 'How many' menanyakan jumlah tuntas + batas 'by the end of December'.
Pola pertanyaan: 'will + subjek + have + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan kantor mengenai prediksi aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung saat itu (Future Continuous).
dialogue: Visitor
Should I knock on Director Tan's door right at two tomorrow?
Assistant
Better wait until three — at two o'clock, she ___ the board's quarterly call.
intermediate.explanation: Pada pukul dua tepat ('at two o'clock'), rapat tersebut SEDANG berlangsung, bukan sudah selesai; gunakan Future Continuous ('will be leading').
hints: Rapatnya sedang berjalan di jam 2 besok.
Gunakan Future Continuous 'will be + V-ing'.

intermediate.prompt: By the time the train crosses the border, I ___ for nearly nine hours without a proper break.
intermediate.explanation: 'By the time + Present Simple (crosses)' menetapkan batas masa depan, sedangkan 'for nearly nine hours' menuntut Future Perfect Continuous ('will have been riding').
hints: Klausa 'By the time...' merujuk ke masa depan (Present Simple 'crosses').
Durasi sembilan jam hingga titik depan memakai 'will have been + V-ing'.

intermediate.prompt: Remember: in future time clauses after 'by the time' or 'before', use Present Simple instead of 'will': 'By the time the courier ___, our office will have closed.'
intermediate.explanation: Jangan memakai 'will' di dalam klausa waktu setelah 'By the time', 'when', atau 'before'; gunakan Present Simple ('arrives').
hints: Ini berada di dalam anak kalimat waktu setelah 'By the time'.
Subjek tunggal 'the courier' memakai Present Simple 'arrives'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menggabungkan stative verb 'know' ke Future Perfect Continuous berikut.
intermediate.draft: By our anniversary next Sunday, my wife and I will have been knowing each other for twelve years.
options: By our anniversary next Sunday, my wife and I will have known each other for twelve years.
By our anniversary next Sunday, my wife and I will have been know each other for twelve years.
By our anniversary next Sunday, my wife and I are knowing each other for twelve years.
intermediate.explanation: Stative verb seperti 'know' tidak boleh berbentuk '-ing' bahkan dengan penanda durasi 'for twelve years'; ubah menjadi Future Perfect Simple ('will have known').
hints: 'Know' adalah stative verb yang terlarang dalam Continuous.
Gunakan Future Perfect Simple 'will have known'.

intermediate.prompt: Please don't phone me between seven and eight tonight; I ___ dinner with overseas clients.
intermediate.explanation: Rentang waktu spesifik di masa depan ('between seven and eight tonight') ketika aktivitas sedang berjalan memakai Future Continuous ('will be having').
hints: Aksi sedang berlangsung selama rentang jam 7–8 malam ini.
Gunakan 'will be having'.

intermediate.prompt: They ___ have owned that coastal bookstore for forty years this October.
intermediate.explanation: 'Own' adalah stative verb kepemilikan, sehingga durasi 'for forty years' hingga Oktober nanti memakai Future Perfect Simple: 'will have owned'.
hints: Ada kata 'have owned' setelah rumpang.
Future Perfect Simple memakai 'will'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Continuous untuk menanyakan rencana orang lain secara sopan (tanpa kesan mendesak).
intermediate.targetSentence: Will you be using the studio tripod later this afternoon?
intermediate.explanation: Menanyakan rencana penggunaan barang secara santun dan tidak menuntut memakai Future Continuous ('Will you be + V-ing?').
hints: Awali dengan 'Will you be using'.
Tambahkan objek dan keterangan waktu.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Perfect Simple dengan klausa 'before + Present Simple'.
intermediate.targetSentence: We will have tested every sensor before the inspection team arrives.
intermediate.explanation: Klausa hasil 'will have + V3', diikuti klausa waktu Present Simple 'before... arrives'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'We will have tested every sensor'.
Akhiri dengan 'before the inspection team arrives'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki penggunaan 'will' di dalam klausa waktu bersyarat waktu depan.
complex.draft: By the time the new regulations will take effect, we will have updated our software.
options: By the time the new regulations take effect, we will have updated our software.
By the time the new regulations will have taken effect, we will update our software.
By the time the new regulations took effect, we will have updated our software.
complex.explanation: Klausa waktu 'by the time...' tidak boleh memakai modal 'will'. Gunakan Present Simple ('take effect').
hints: Hilangkan 'will' dari klausa 'by the time'.
Gunakan 'take effect'.

complex.prompt: Evaluate the semantic distinction: (1) 'I will meet the CEO' vs (2) 'I will be meeting the CEO'.
options: (1) expresses decision/intention; (2) expresses an arrangement as part of regular routine without fresh decision.
complex.explanation: 'Will be meeting' menyatakan bahwa pertemuan tersebut terjadi secara wajar/terjadwal sebagai bagian dari rutinitas atau agenda tanpa niat mendadak.
hints: Future Continuous menunjukkan hal yang terjadi secara wajar/terjadwal.
Pilih opsi rutinitas/agenda terjadwal.

complex.prompt: By the time the treaty is ratified next spring, the delegations ___ for thirty-six months.
complex.explanation: Durasi negosiasi diplomasi yang terus berlanjut hingga ratifikasi tahun depan ('will have been negotiating').
hints: Menekankan durasi diplomasi yang panjang.
Gunakan Future Perfect Continuous.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat analisis proyeksi finansial kuartal empat.
complex.targetSentence: By December the company will have achieved all its quarterly targets.
complex.explanation: By December + the company will have achieved + all its quarterly targets.
hints: Mulai dengan 'By December'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'the company will have achieved all its quarterly targets'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan bentuk kata kerja stative pada klausa masa depan.
complex.draft: By 2030, our organization will have been possessing this patent for twenty years.
options: By 2030, our organization will have possessed this patent for twenty years.
By 2030, our organization will possess this patent for twenty years.
By 2030, our organization will be possessing this patent for twenty years.
complex.explanation: 'Possess' adalah kata kerja stative (kepemilikan), tidak boleh dalam bentuk continuous. Gunakan Future Perfect Simple: 'will have possessed'.
hints: 'Possess' adalah stative verb.
Ganti dengan 'will have possessed'.

complex.prompt: Predicting present continuous action: 'Look at the time! Professor Evans ___ papers in his study right now.'
complex.explanation: Modal 'will be + V-ing' dapat digunakan untuk membuat deduksi/prediksi tentang apa yang kemungkinan besar sedang berlangsung saat ini ('will be grading').
hints: Deduksi aksi yang diasumsikan sedang berlangsung sekarang.
Gunakan 'will be grading'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog konfirmasi jadwal audit eksternal.
dialogue: Managing Director
Can we schedule the briefing on Thursday afternoon?
Compliance Officer
The independent auditors ___ our books all afternoon, so Friday morning would be far better.
complex.explanation: Menjelaskan aktivitas yang dijadwalkan berlangsung sepanjang sore hari Kamis ('will be reviewing').
hints: Aktivitas yang akan sedang berlangsung terjadwal.
Gunakan Future Continuous.

complex.prompt: Look at this inferential (deductive) use of Future Perfect: 'Wait — why are you rushing to the airport now? The London flight ___ by now!'
complex.explanation: Selain waktu mendatang, 'will have + V3' sering dipakai untuk DEDUKSI logis mengenai hal yang hampir pasti SUDAH terjadi pada saat ini ('by now' = pastinya sekarang sudah mendarat).
hints: Perhatikan 'by now' yang berarti asumsi pasti saat ini.
'Will have + V3' dapat menyatakan deduksi logis masa kini.

complex.prompt: Similarly, Future Continuous can express present supposition: 'Don't wake Maya up; at this hour in Berlin, she ___ soundly.'
complex.explanation: 'Will be + V-ing' kerap menyatakan dugaan logis tentang apa yang kemungkinan besar sedang dilakukan seseorang saat ini di zona waktu lain ('at this hour in Berlin').
hints: Menduga aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung saat ini di zona waktu berbeda.
Gunakan 'will be + V-ing'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk pasif Future Perfect dan pengandaian klausa waktu berikut.
complex.draft: By the time our regional audit will conclude next month, forty new compliance standards will have been adopting.
options: By the time our regional audit concludes next month, forty new compliance standards will have been adopted.
By the time our regional audit will conclude next month, forty new compliance standards will have adopted.
By the time our regional audit concludes next month, forty new compliance standards will have been adopting.
complex.explanation: Dua perbaikan penting: 1) setelah 'By the time', hilangkan 'will' menjadi Present Simple ('concludes'); 2) standar diadopsi secara pasif, jadi pakai Future Perfect Passive ('will have been adopted', V3).
hints: Cek klausa waktu ('By the time...') dan bentuk pasif standar kebijakan.
Future Perfect Passive berpola 'will have been + V3'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan negosiasi sopan memakai Future Continuous ('Will you be + V-ing?') agar tidak terdengar seperti perintah.
dialogue: Intern
Which phrasing sounds more tactful to ask our senior partner about his travel?
Mentor
Ask '___ to the Jakarta summit this Thursday?' — it asks about existing plans without pressuring him.
complex.explanation: 'Will you be flying...?' terdengar jauh lebih sopan dan tidak memaksa daripada 'Will you fly...?' (yang terkesan menagih janji/kesediaan).
hints: Future Continuous berfungsi menanyakan rencana yang sudah terjadwal secara halus.
Pilih 'Will you be flying'.

complex.prompt: In March, the solar observatory ___ data continuously for five years, barring any unexpected grid failures.
complex.explanation: Subjek pelaku ('the solar observatory') terus mengumpulkan data selama 5 tahun hingga Maret mendatang: bentuk aktif 'will have been gathering'.
hints: Subjeknya pelaku aktif pengumpul data.
Durasi berkelanjutan menuju titik masa depan memakai 'will have been + V-ing'.

complex.prompt: By the end of the fiscal quarter, nearly half of the legacy terminals ___ replaced under the hardware refresh plan.
complex.explanation: Future Perfect Passive ('will have been + V3') menyatakan proses penggantian yang sudah tuntas sebelum akhir kuartal.
hints: Ada V3 'replaced' bermakna pasif di belakang rumpang.
Future Perfect Passive memakai 'will have been'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menyisipkan Future Perfect di dalam klausa 'once' berikut.
complex.draft: Once the technicians will have finished calibrating the radar, shipping traffic can resume.
options: Once the technicians have finished calibrating the radar, shipping traffic can resume.
Once the technicians will finish calibrating the radar, shipping traffic can resume.
Once the technicians had finished calibrating the radar, shipping traffic can resume tomorrow.
complex.explanation: Dalam time clause masa depan setelah 'Once', 'when', atau 'as soon as', JANGAN pakai 'will'; untuk menekankan penyelesaian prasyarat di klausa waktu, gunakan Present Simple atau Present Perfect ('have finished').
hints: Setelah konjungsi waktu 'Once', 'will' dilarang keras.
Gunakan Present Perfect ('have finished') untuk aksi prasyarat selesai.

complex.prompt: Wait — if we take the late train, everyone ___ for an hour by the time we arrive, so we'll only catch the closing remarks.
complex.explanation: Durasi menunggu ('for an hour') yang berlangsung hingga saat kedatangan kita di masa depan ('by the time we arrive') memakai 'will have been waiting'.
hints: Ada batas depan ('by the time we arrive') dan durasi ('for an hour').
Pilih Future Perfect Continuous.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi kini dengan Future Continuous.
complex.targetSentence: The Singapore team will probably be wrapping up their morning briefing right now.
complex.explanation: 'Will probably be wrapping up right now' menebak secara logis aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung saat ini.
hints: Awali dengan 'The Singapore team will probably be'.
Lengkapi dengan 'wrapping up their morning briefing right now'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Perfect Passive dengan batas waktu 'before midnight'.
complex.targetSentence: Every encrypted backup file will have been verified before midnight.
complex.explanation: Subjek pasif + will have been + V3 ('verified') + before midnight.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Every encrypted backup file will have been'.
Akhiri dengan 'verified before midnight'.
